business: The Saltglass Inn is a twelve-room inn on the harbor road in Wrenmouth, a seaside town. Mira and Joe Calloway run it for couples, families and people traveling with a dog, and host small family gatherings in its garden. They gave the four facts on the proof strip: each of the twelve rooms has its own bath, breakfast is cooked to order, dogs are welcome in four rooms, and parking on site is free. They also gave three reviews from guests who agreed to be quoted by first name and last initial, each rated 5 out of 5. The phone, (555) 555-0174, and the email, hello@saltglass-inn.example.com, are set in Settings > Site Data, so the page binds them and no copy types them.

Review 1 quote.text: We woke up to the boats coming in. Breakfast alone was worth the trip.

Review 2 quote.text: Our dog was as welcome as we were. Mira had a bowl of water waiting.

Review 3 quote.text: We had the garden for my mother's seventieth. Joe made it easy from start to end.
